notes.title: JUST SKATEBOARD OUT NOW!
notes.content:
You like skateboarding? Then this is the game for you!

Just skate, do tricks in different locations and enjoy the process.

In the game you will find:
- 1 skateboard
- 3 locations for skating
- achievements
- relax music

Enjoy skating!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3325600/JUST_SKATEBOARD/
